FN-DGY79TN-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 513
Committee: Public Safety and Homeland Sponsor: Representative Bryan Brinyark
Security
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/08/2025
House Bill 513 as introduced could increase receipts to the Public Safety Fund by an estimated
maximum of $667,000 annually by providing for the Alabama Law Enforcement Agency
(ALEA) to increase the fee for certain background checks from either $15 or $25, under current
law, up to $30, as provided in this bill.
In addition, this bill could further increase the receipts to the Public Safety Fund by $12
annually for each individual enrolled in the Alabama Rap Back Program, which ALEA may
establish pursuant to this bill. Per ALEA, these fees will offset any costs incurred to administer
the program.
Finally, this bill could increase receipts to the State General Fund and municipal general funds
from fines; increase receipts to the State General Fund, county general funds, municipal general
funds, and other funds to which court costs are deposited; and could increase the obligations of
the State General Fund, district attorneys, and local jails by an undetermined amount dependent
upon the number of persons charged with and convicted of the offenses provided by this bill and
the penalties imposed.
Page 1
